services.name: Sip & Sail Wine Sail
services.desc: Wine and Sail Tour, Step aboard the Pineapple Ketch for a 90 minute coastal escape blending the scenic wonder of the Kennebunkport coastline with a curated selection of wines and an artisanal charcuterie cup served by Betsy Ross of Wine House on Maine. This intimate experience welcomes up to 10 guests for a beautiful evening. Betsy Ross is a Certified Sommelier and the owner of Wine House on Main in Kennebunk, Maine. With over 20 years of experience in hospitality, Betsy has built wine programs and led service teams at some of the nation’s most iconic venues—including Michelin-starred Ages 21+ • 1.5 Hour Sail • Public and Private Options Available

services.name: Evening Sail
services.desc: Sunset Sail About Come aboard The Pineapple Ketch for the perfect end of your day in Kennebunkport. This romantic hour and a half sail will take you out the mouth of the Kennebunk river and up the rocky coast of Kennebunkport. These trips are not only for couples but anyone who dreams of sailing with soft light bouncing off the water and illuminating our stunning shoreline. Evening sails depart from the Nonantum Resort in Kennebunkport. We find great sailing during the hours prior to sunset. Complimentary soda and water are provided but we encourage you to bring whatever snack or beverage you Ages 5+ • 1.5 Hour Sail • Public and Private Options Available

quotes.text: Justin and Captain Jim were fantastic guides, and gave us some history of the surrounding area, restaurant, recommendations, and houses that we saw on the cruise. We took the midday sailing cruise, and it was just beautiful to be on the Atlantic in good weather. I very much recommend this cruise.

quotes.text: The Captains were very informative on sailing and all the sights to be seen from the boat. They had interesting tales to tell as well. Very enjoyable & relaxing sail, could've spent all day out at sea!! I highly recommend taking the trip!!

quotes.text: Nice sailboat. Comfortable seats. Friendly and informative crew. Great view of the estates along Ocean Drive. We had a beautiful day and a nice smooth ride. Strongly recommend.
